result.summary: The page mostly renders correctly, but there is one clear defect: an untranslated localization key ('home_feed.popular_title') is shown as a section heading instead of actual text. A few minor layout/truncation issues are also present.

issues.description: The section heading displays the raw localization key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of the translated title (e.g., 'Popular near you').
issues.suggestion: Add the missing translation string for this key in the localization files and provide a fallback (e.g., default English string) when a key is missing.

issues.description: The third card in the 'Fastest near you' carousel is cut off and its name is truncated ('Trattoria Piccol...') without an ellipsis or clear affordance.
issues.suggestion: This is expected for a horizontal carousel, but ensure truncated names use ellipsis styling and the partial card visibly hints at scrollability (e.g., peek width tuned consistently).

issues.description: The category chip row is cut off at the right edge, showing a sliver of an empty chip after 'Healthy'.
issues.suggestion: Adjust chip spacing/peek so the next chip shows enough of its label to indicate more categories are available.
